candidates.desc: In a 3D-animated hay field a kid pinky-promises a big farmer to catch him; the man does a trust fall, the kid steps aside and he crashes into the hay, sitting up covered in straw and betrayed while the kid grins.
In an animated night scene, a young woman cries on brownstone steps; her friend sits down, puts an arm around her, hands her a tissue and a mug of hot cocoa, and she slowly smiles again.

A 3D-animated young woman faces a doubting friend who stands with crossed arms. She kicks up into a perfect handstand, holds it while his face turns from smug to amazed, then lands; he applauds and admits she won.

In a bright cafe, a woman with iced drinks glances sideways at her friend, raises her eyebrows as the voiceover says her friend did something silly "but I do not judge her", then breaks into a warm smile and the two clink their glasses.

In a café strung with fairy lights, a young woman with bright red cheeks hides her face behind both hands, then peeks out and gives a small embarrassed wave. Another woman opens a handwritten note, reads it and goes pink to the ears, grinning at the page. At a table of cappuccinos the whole group laughs together, everyone's cheeks flushed, as they say nice things to each other.

A group of teenagers sit around a low table in a school common room. One boy in a navy hoodie holds out his left arm, which is in a white plaster cast supported by a sling. His friends take coloured felt-tip pens out of a white cup and write their names and messages on the cast, one adding a yellow sun and another a scribbled signature. By the end the cast is covered in names and drawings in green, orange, blue and red, and the boy holds his arm up and laughs at it.

A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.

A room lit by blue and orange fairy lights. A red-haired young man sits on a sofa under a striped blanket, crying, holding a yellow mug in both hands. A friend rests a hand on his shoulder, then a young woman sits down beside him and rubs his arm, and two more friends close in from behind. They wrap their arms around him together in one tight group hug, faces pressed against his shoulders, while he goes on crying.

Two young men stand on a suburban pavement beside a low brick wall with a road bike leaning against it. One in a navy hoodie stands with his arms folded tight and his jaw set, refusing to look up. The other, in black with a takeaway coffee cup, leans on the wall and talks to him steadily. The folded arms drop, the first one looks down and half-smiles, and the two step together into a long hug over the wall.

An exhausted female runner wearing race bib 134 is held up under both arms by a man in a grey cap and a young woman in a rainbow tri-suit at the end of a city road race. Spectators behind metal barriers clap and shout. The three walk her forward together across the finish line, then stop and fall into a tight group hug, crying and laughing.

A narrow old stone alley with steps, wet with rain at dusk, lit by an iron street lamp. A man in a soaked light-blue shirt and dark jeans raises one hand and puts the other on his chest with a sheepish grin, admitting his mistake, then laughs and covers his face with his hand. Facing him, a young woman in a maroon raincoat, cream top and brown skirt holds a blue umbrella and smiles with one hand on her hip. A wet scruffy terrier beside him shakes the water off its fur.

In an old stone courtyard with a heavy wooden door, a young man in a cream T-shirt and navy trousers kneels on the mossy flagstones and holds the boot of a young woman in both hands. She wears a rust top, grey trousers and brown boots and grips the top of the high stone wall. He rises and pushes her up until she climbs onto the top and crouches there, laughing down at him while he stands below and smiles up. A coiled rope hangs from the wall and a brown paper parcel leans against it.

At a harbour at dusk in the rain, under a green wooden shelter with a corrugated roof and a glowing lamp, a young woman in a burgundy jumper and wide black trousers leans over and pulls a navy rain jacket over the head of a young man in a white T-shirt who sits on a bench looking down. She settles the jacket round his shoulders, he looks up and smiles at her, and she rests her head against his. A broken umbrella lies inside out on the wet ground, and a black dog sits beside him.

In a living room in the evening with dark green walls, a green tiled stove, tall windows and a brass pendant lamp, a young woman with long braids, in pink pyjamas, sits on a rust-coloured velvet sofa under a cream knitted blanket and eats ice cream from a tub with a spoon. Her friend, dressed to go out in a sequined top, a black leather skirt and heels, with a small gold bag, stands beside the sofa, throws her hands out in disbelief and talks to her, then lets her arms drop. A candle burns on the table.

On a snowy mountain top at sunset, five young men in bright retro ski suits in purple, teal and blue are piled together on an old beige sofa in the snow, laughing and shouting. One lies across the others' laps, one pours a hot drink from a flask that spills onto the snow, and others raise enamel mugs. A shaggy grey dog in a bobble hat stands on the back of the sofa and shakes its head. A stone cairn is behind them, and backpacks lie beside the sofa as snow blows past.

In a bright hotel bedroom, a laughing young woman with long curly dark hair in a white bathrobe kneels on a big white bed and swings a pillow that hits a blonde young woman on the side of the head, and feathers burst into the air. The blonde woman laughs and hits back with her own pillow as the fight goes on. A breakfast tray with croissants and a spilled glass of orange juice lies on the bed, pale dresses hang on a wooden wardrobe, and a third woman laughs in an armchair.

On a wet street corner of an old town, a young man and a young woman meet by chance, both wearing identical mustard rain jackets and navy striped scarves. She covers her mouth in surprise and he laughs; then they both laugh, and he taps his forehead. Each holds a leash, and their two corgis sniff noses between them. Buckets of red and yellow tulips stand against the stone wall with ivy, a bicycle leans nearby, and a baker smiles from a doorway behind.

Seen from above, in a cosy bedroom at night, a young man in a white T-shirt and striped pyjama bottoms kneels in the middle of a bed and swings pillows left and right to push back laughing young women in pyjamas who reach for him from all sides. He hits out again and again as feathers burst into the air. Fairy lights lie on the bedspread, trays of croissants sit on the bed and the bedside table, an open suitcase spills clothes, and a dog sits at the foot of the bed.

On a snowy city street at night, under falling snow and green traffic lights, a smiling young man in a camel coat leans his whole weight against the back of a small white car stuck in the snow and pushes it. The car moves forward, he straightens up laughing and steps up to the driver's window. The young woman driving leans out, laughing and waving a white mitten. A paper grocery bag lies in the snow beside them, with oranges and a baguette spilling out, and people with umbrellas watch from the pavement.

A busy railway station platform under a high arched glass roof. A young woman in a brown jacket and blue top jumps into the arms of a young woman in a lilac coat, her legs kicking up and her hair flying, and is held up in the air. She slides down and the two hug tightly, both crying with their eyes shut. Their backpacks have dropped to the floor. A train stands at the platform, and a conductor and passengers walk past and smile.

A frozen lake in winter at sunrise, with snowy pine trees and a small red wooden sauna cabin. A young woman in a swimsuit sits in a square hole cut in the ice, laughing and waving him in. A young man kneeling on the snow pulls his dark red hoodie off over his head and drops it, raises his hands with a resigned grin, his bare chest in the cold air, and starts to get up to join her. A husky stands by the cabin, and a pair of boots stands in the snow.

Inside an old car with tan leather seats, looking at the back seat from the front. Three young friends squeeze together on the back seat. In the centre a laughing young woman in a mustard jumper and denim shorts leans forward, then sits back with her arms crossed and her knees pressed together, with one person on each side of her: on the left a young man in a white T-shirt and blue shorts, on the right a young woman in a burgundy jumper and cream skirt. Green hedges are visible through the windows.

A narrow hallway in an old flat with dark red walls, a wooden floor and a bicycle. A young woman in a burgundy hoodie and shorts stands on a wooden chair and balances a metal bucket full of water and ice on top of a half-open door. A young man crouches beside the chair, holding it steady with his finger on his lips. A young woman in a mustard top comes down the hall laughing and hurries out of view. The first woman jumps down, and both crouch by the chair, grinning and watching the door.

A sunny rooftop terrace above a city in warm evening light. Three young friends lean together over a blue tiled table and dip long spoons into one tall glass of ice cream sundae with fruit and cream: a young woman with locs in a cream knit top, a young man in a beige shirt and a young woman in a mustard jacket. They eat, laugh and feed each other from their spoons. Glasses of water, a jug with lemon slices and potted plants stand around them.

A mirror selfie of a young woman with curly dark hair in a long striped shirt and cream shorts, laughing as she holds up her phone in a friend's bedroom. Behind her a young woman in a white vest and shorts, her hair in a messy bun, jumps off the double bed with a blue duvet and bends down by the bed, laughing. On the patterned rug a dachshund sniffs an open overnight bag, with socks and a toothbrush lying on the floor. The room has yellow walls, a bookshelf and an orange ceiling lamp.
